name: Artiza Networks, Inc.
summary: Artiza Networks, Inc. provides radio access network and core network node testing products to mobile network operators, network equipment manufacturers, system integrators, and other types of companies in the telecommunications industry. It provides gNodeB and eNodeB testing products, including Duo SIM-advanced functional and load testers, environmental simulators, QoE optimization, packet capture tools, and board related products. The company also offers functional testing, performance testing, product demonstration, and 5G solutions. In addition, it provides centralized RAN, carrier aggregation, Internet of Things, and quality assurance solutions. The company was formerly known as Able Communication Inc. and changed its name to Artiza Networks, Inc. in 2001. Artiza Networks, Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Tachikawa, Japan.
